pages.text: Gamma-ray bursts come from anywhere in the sky, about once a day bright enough to catch. A lower trigger threshold Eth catches fainter ones (rate ∝ e^(−Eth/50 keV)) - and more noise. Over a watch of t hours the chance of catching at least one is 1 − e^(−N), N the bursts expected; the false triggers grow as t·e^(−Eth/8 keV).
$(thing)Set$(): Trigger threshold, Watch.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Background: the noise rate varies by ±20%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Shorter watches report sooner.
